evidence_type: direct assay (in vitro redox manipulation) + structure
claim_tested: AcrIIC1 C17-C80 forms an inactive disulphide-linked dimer; monomer is active
key_finding: Switch demonstrated with 1 mM DTT and 5-fold molar excess H2O2 (and air). Full-text mining of PMC9674691: 'midpoint' 0 hits, 'glutathione' 0, 'GSH' 0, 'GSSG' 0, 'diamide' 0, 'mV' 2 occurrences. No midpoint potential was determined. The only quantitative statement is 'It seems that normal cytoplasmic values (-260 to -200 mV) fall within the range of our reducing buffers (-360 to -200 mV), indicating most of the AcrIIC1 molecules should be at their reduced state under normal physiological conditions.'
context: Purified NmeAcrIIC1 in vitro; in-cell assay in E. coli with 1 mM exogenous H2O2
confidence_limitations: High confidence that the disulphide exists and is inhibitory in vitro. The -260 to -200 mV range is cited to two eukaryotic reviews (Go & Jones 2008 BBA 1780:1273-1290; Jones & Go 2010 Diabetes Obes Metab 12:116-125), not to a bacterial measurement. No E0' for the couple.

claim_tested: What redox potential does a Gram-negative cytoplasm actually hold?
key_finding: Grx1-roGFP2 in the E. coli cytoplasm: OxD 0.068 +/- 0.016; E_glutathione = -314.4 mV (99% CI -313.8 to -315.1 mV), using E'0(Grx1-roGFP2) = -280 mV, z=2, T=298.15 K.
context: E. coli MG1655 cytoplasm, live cells, 405/488 nm excitation ratio at 525 nm emission, AT-2 and DTT normalisation
confidence_limitations: Primary measurement with a named method. Not N. meningitidis; transfer across species is inference. Reports EGSH, which equals the ambient potential only for couples that equilibrate with glutathione.

claim_tested: Does the compartment matter for an exposed cysteine pair?
key_finding: E. coli periplasm -228 mV (WT) and -243 mV (delta-dsbA) by roGFP2/roGFP-iL, about 70-90 mV more oxidising than the cytoplasm measured in the same lab's system.
confidence_limitations: Primary. Establishes the compartment gap that makes the localisation arm decisive.

claim_tested: Would the N. meningitidis periplasm oxidise an exposed cysteine pair?
key_finding: Neisserial DsbA1/2/3 have E0' near -80 mV, described as the most oxidising thioredoxin-like enzymes known.
context: N. meningitidis periplasmic DsbA paralogues, purified
confidence_limitations: Primary and organism-matched, but applies to the periplasm, a compartment AcrIIC1 never enters.

claim_tested: Does AcrIIC1 carry any export signal?
key_finding: No Signal, Transit peptide, Lipidation or Transmembrane feature. No lipobox [LVIFA][ASTVILG][GAS]C in residues 1-40, no Tat RR-x-phi-phi in residues 1-30. Residues 1-86 modelled as ordered in six structures. Positive controls from the same organism (NmDsbA-1 Q9K189 Signal 1-18 + lipobox LAAC; PilB Q9K1N8 lipobox LGAC) show what a real signal looks like.
confidence_limitations: Dedicated signal-peptide prediction could not be run: EBI Phobius REST returned HTTP 400 'You have been temporarily blocked'. No SignalP or Phobius output is reported. The motif and feature checks are direct; the absence call is inference from them.

citation: NCBI Entrez protein (198 records, 109 unique, 97 aligned) + PDB 9J2G
claim_tested: Are the two cysteines conserved, and has any lineage lost them?
key_finding: Both Cys17 and Cys80 retained in 11 of 96 non-identical homologs. 50 of 97 carry fewer than two cysteines in the entire protein. Neisseria leonii WP_338691710.1 (55.0% id) has Ala at 17 and one Cys in total. Campylobacter sp. CAQ9404609.1 (59.5% id) has Ser at 17, Cys at 80. AcrIIC1Vei (V. eiseniae, WP_086014401.1 / PDB 9J2G chain B, 32.9% id) has zero cysteines and is a characterised type II-C Cas9 inhibitor.
context: Needleman-Wunsch, BLOSUM62, gap open -11 extend -1, hand-implemented; query = UniProt A0A2D0TCG3
confidence_limitations: Per-protein cysteine counts are alignment-independent and solid. Below about 40% identity the column-level calls from global pairwise alignment are weak. No curated multiple alignment or HMM was built.

citation: UniProt proteome UP000000425 + KEGG (nme, ngo, eco)
claim_tested: Does N. meningitidis encode the systems that set the cytoplasmic potential?
key_finding: Present: TrxB Q9JZ28 (EC 1.8.1.9, CATC@134); thioredoxins Q9JYY9 (CGPC@34), Q9JXN4 (CPGC@60), Q9JXX7 (CGVC@71), Q9K067 (CSLC@11); glutaredoxins Q9JY15 (CPYC@12), Q7DD88 (CPFC@9); gshA Q9JZI4, gshB Q9JYJ3. Absent: glutathione reductase. KEGG K00383 (Gor) is in eco:b3500 but has no ortholog in nme or ngo; UniProt returns zero hits for EC 1.8.1.7 or gene:gor in taxon 487.
context: N. meningitidis MC58 proteome; KEGG orthology presence/absence
confidence_limitations: Database-level. Presence of a gene is not a measured potential. The missing Gor means the measured E. coli EGSH is a poor proxy for the dominant reducing couple in N. meningitidis.

claim_tested: Is the neisserial cytoplasmic thiol-reducing system active in vivo?
key_finding: TrxB protects N. meningitidis against disulphide stress and is required for intracellular survival.
confidence_limitations: Primary and organism-matched; shows the Trx pathway is functional, but gives no potential.

claim_tested: Is periplasmic disulphide handling essential in this organism?
key_finding: DsbD is essential in N. meningitidis.
confidence_limitations: Primary; periplasmic, so indirect for the cytoplasmic question.

claim_tested: How negative do bacterial thioredoxin couples go?
key_finding: M. tuberculosis TrxB and TrxC midpoints -262 and -269 mV.
confidence_limitations: Primary but a different phylum; used only as a calibration bound on how negative a protein dithiol couple gets.

claim_tested: Could the disulphide form at the measured cytoplasmic potential?
key_finding: At an ambient -314.4 mV, holding even 10% of AcrIIC1 as the disulphide requires a C17-C80 midpoint of -342.6 mV, and 50% requires -314.4 mV. E. coli Trx1, among the most reducing protein dithiol couples known, sits at about -270 mV. Against the -260 mV Zhao assumed, 10% oxidation still needs -288.2 mV.
context: Two-electron thiol-disulphide equilibrium, z=2, T=298.15 K
confidence_limitations: Direct calculation, but it takes the measured E. coli EGSH as the ambient potential for N. meningitidis and assumes the couple equilibrates with it. It is an upper bound on oxidation: C17-C80 is interchain, so dimerisation entropy penalises the disulphide further at physiological concentrations. It does not substitute for measuring the midpoint.
